purpose: Test whether causal path geometry and signal-time activity/price state reduce uncertainty about multi-scale turning outcomes inside the established point-in-time quality-liquidity pool.

period.annual_fit_rule: For evaluation year y, fit only episodes whose resolution date index is strictly earlier than the first evaluated onset date index in y.

outcome_semantics.same_day_resolutions: known state confirmations excluded from both fitting and prediction
outcome_semantics.right_censored: excluded from scored binary outcomes and separately counted

feature_sets.fit_standardization: mean and population standard deviation from already-resolved training episodes only

models.scale_prior: Jeffreys Beta(1/2,1/2) posterior mean within episode type and scale pair
models.conditional_family: separate L2-regularized Bernoulli logistic regression for every episode type and scale pair
models.regularization_selection: global within each feature family by discovery-period date-equal log loss, using the strongest regularization inside one HAC standard error of the minimum

evaluation.headline_weighting: first equal-weight episode outcomes within each date/type/scale cell, then equal-weight cells within date
evaluation.information_unit: bits per prediction from out-of-sample log-loss reduction
evaluation.multiple_testing: Benjamini-Hochberg two-sided q-values across the 16 episode-type/scale cells
